issues.legal_issue: The limitation period for seeking compensation redetermination runs from the reference court award on which the request is based, not from a later appellate decision.
material_facts: Interested persons sought redetermination of compensation based on awards made by a court on references under the land acquisition law.
An appellate court later altered the compensation rate, but the redetermination applications were filed more than three months after the reference court awards on which they were based.
The applications were rejected as time-barred, and the High Court upheld that rejection.
issues.conclusion: The limitation period began on the date of the reference court award underlying each request, rather than on the date of an appellate decision. The applications were time-barred, and the appeals were dismissed.
issues.legal_principle: Under Sections 28-A and 18 of the Land Acquisition Act, 1894, read with Section 2(d), the relevant ‘Court’ is the principal civil court of original jurisdiction hearing the reference. Section 28-A’s plain language measures the three-month period from the award of that court, not from an appellate court’s decision. Babua Ram v. State of U.P. and Union of India v. Karnail Singh were overruled only insofar as they confined the right to the earliest reference award; Union of India v. Pradeep Kumari establishes that the period runs from the reference award on which redetermination is sought.

predicates.compensation_redetermination_application: A person made an application seeking redetermination of compensation for acquired land.
predicates.reference_court_award_basis: The person relied on an award made by a court deciding a compensation reference as the basis for the requested redetermination.
predicates.filed_after_reference_award_deadline: The person made the application after the applicable filing period measured from the reference court award had expired.

issues.definition: A compensation redetermination application based on a reference court award is time-barred when it is made after the filing deadline measured from that award.
